traversal_method: Prescribed analytical full-primary visitation tour, including voluntary M05/M09/M10 and required return. No participant checklist or cue. Sum shortest collision-cleared orthogonal paths between these waypoints at175px/s. Excludes reading, tasks, interactions, deliberate stops, search errors and scene-load delay; not a human timing estimate or globally shortest tour. M08/M11 optional jobs and inventory detours excluded.
